intro.title: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user registration form with real-time validation. You'll learn how to combine React Hook Form for managing form state with Zod, a TypeScript-first schema library, to define and enforce validation rules. The core concept is integrating a schema validator into a form handler to ensure user input is correct before submission. You'll use the `useForm` hook, Zod's `z.object()` to create a schema, and the `resolver` from `@hookform/resolvers/zod` to connect them. By the end, your form will display clear error messages when invalid data is entered.
intro.usecase: Form validation with Zod and React Hook Form is essential in any application that collects user data, from simple contact forms to complex multi-step registration processes. You'll see this pattern in e-commerce checkout flows where address, payment, and shipping information must be validated before submission. Enterprise dashboards use it for data entry forms where users input financial figures, user permissions, or configuration settings that require strict type safety. Customer relationship management (CRM) systems implement this approach when creating new client records, ensuring email formats, phone numbers, and required fields are properly validated before saving to databases.
